pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark polygons with jagged, oak-leaf-like margins. High edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients between dark and light regions. Patch area is significantly larger on the neck and shoulder than on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the dark patches. Junction nodes typically connect three to four pathways. Pixel thickness of pathways is greater on the neck region compared to the thinner channels on the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D jagged silhouette along the upper neck, characterized by high-frequency and low-amplitude spikes. The mane terminates or flattens at the shoulder junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian symbionts (oxpeckers) attached to the coat: one on the upper tail base, one on the mid-flank, and one on the lower shoulder area.
